title: F$^3$: What Makes Good Experience in World-Action Models?
abstract: arXiv:2611.24708v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deployed world-action models (WAMs) can keep improving only if they make good use of their own experience. Existing methods supply retrieved rollouts or demonstrations to the policy as context, yet such experience often turns previously solved tasks into failures. What, then, makes good experience for a WAM? We show that experience is valuable only in use: its value depends not on whether the source rollout succeeded but on what is stored, when it is used, and where it enters the policy. We therefore propose F$^3$, which makes these three decisions with Form, Fit, and Fusion. Form compresses successful and failed rollouts alike into short, verified operation records; Fit teaches the policy to read a record and to predict when it helps; Fusion injects the record's images, text and actions into the policy as a prefix and an action prior. translated_title: F³：什么构成了世界-动作模型中的良好经验？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.24708v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：已部署的世界-动作模型（WAM）只有善用自身经验才能持续改进。现有方法将检索到的轨迹或示范作为上下文提供给策略，然而这样的经验常常使之前已成功解决的任务变为失败。那么，什么才是对WAM而言的良好经验？我们表明，经验只有在使用时才有价值：其价值不取决于源轨迹是否成功，而取决于存储了什么、何时使用以及从何处进入策略。因此，我们提出了F³，通过形式、契合与融合来做出这三个决策。Form将成功和失败的轨迹都压缩为简短的、经过验证的操作记录；Fit教会策略读取记录并预测其何时有帮助；Fusion将记录的图像、文本和动作作为前缀和动作先验注入策略中。仅在200个样本上训练一次，并配合不断增长的经验库进行部署，该模型实现了……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出F³框架，通过形式、契合与融合三个决策让世界-动作模型有效利用自身经验（包括成功与失败的轨迹），仅需200个样本训练一次即可实现持续改进。
en_tdlr: Proposes F³, a framework that enables world-action models to effectively leverage their own experience—including both successful and failed rollouts—through three decisions of Form, Fit, and Fusion, achieving continuous improvement with only 200 training examples.
